body:
N-34 SLICE 1, review blocker fixed (helper-n34s1, 16 Nov 2026 night; PR #111; still BUILT, NOT WALKED, the item stays todo).
BLOCKER: the CHANGELOG line said a live upload or a cover is never taken for the studio song and a song on a compilation is left alone. Both false as written (the reviewer's run, reproduced by two new tests). FIXED AT THE SOURCE OF THE FALSE SENTENCE: the line now says what the matcher does: it refuses an entry whose own title names another version (the catalogue's LABEL decides), a cover by another artist, an album credited to somebody else (tribute, Various Artists), a release type that is not album/ep/single, a name the fold cannot hold; and it says what it cannot tell by name: (1) a live UPLOAD with the studio title and length is the studio song, (2) a same-artist best-of typed album is chosen when the original album is not among the hits.
PINNED, so nobody states the opposite again (tests/test_album_finder.py): test_what_refuses_a_live_hit_is_the_catalogues_label_and_nothing_else_... (the recorded Wembley hit with its label removed is same_recording; the studio hit is too) and test_a_best_of_by_the_same_artist_that_the_catalogue_types_album_is_chosen_when_it_is_the_only_release_... (derived from the recorded best-of: matched, 2011-11-08, album). Both pass on the old code (they guard behaviour that was already there), so each was mutated in a throwaway copy and SEEN FAILING for the right reason: a title heuristic refusing 'best of' turns the second red (none / no_eligible_release instead of matched); a refusal by the hit's album title ('live') turns the first red (title_or_version instead of same_recording). If a refusal is ever added, change the test and the CHANGELOG line together.
I DID NOT ADD A REFUSAL (the review offered it): a title heuristic would not make 'a compilation is left alone' true either (a best-of called 'Gold' passes), and what a same-artist best-of becomes is a design choice that slice 2 would store as a permanent stamp. FOR THE LEAD, BEFORE SLICE 2 STORES A STAMP: step 0 recorded no compilation or live record_type, so nothing proves the type refuses a same-artist best-of. Choose: (a) accept (the earliest date makes the original win whenever it is among the hits), (b) a title heuristic as a second layer with its removal trigger, (c) ask the artist's discography for the first release of the song. My view: (c) is the proper source, (b) only on top of it.
NOT TOUCHED (the review marked them information): the Arabic rows hold only through the unsupported guard (whichever of #110 and #111 merges second must rewrite them to assert no match by key inequality); album() second gather now passes wait_s=left at the gate for a person route (the PR says defaults unchanged: loosely pinned); album_dryrun fixture_name slug collisions; _id_order with a non-ASCII digit; the record_type counts in the album_finder docstring (49/1/13) do not match the fixtures (6 album, 13 single, 1 ep for LANDMVRKS); the dry-run timing test.
Gate on the head of this push: see the PR.
